components.name: PieChart
components.description: Part-to-whole angular and annular sector visualization with solid pie and donut variants, center metrics, and interactive sector expansion.

components.name: Treemap

components.name: TreeDiagram
components.description: Explicit hierarchical parent-child topology visualization with horizontal, vertical, and collapsible variants, ancestor path highlighting, and pan/zoom.

components.name: SankeyDiagram
components.description: Multi-stage quantitative transfer and conversion visualization with deterministic column staging, non-crossing ribbon stacking, and path isolation.

components.name: NetworkDiagram
components.description: Arbitrary relational graph and topology visualization with deterministic force-directed physics, circular layout, neighborhood isolation, and node search.

components.name: GeoMap
components.description: Geographic and spatial visualization component with Mercator/Equirectangular projection, curved logistics freight corridors, proportional hub symbols, choropleth fills, and WCAG 1.4.1 hatch patterns.

components.name: RangeChart
components.description: Bounded interval and uncertainty visualization component supporting floating interval bars, dumbbell delta links, error whiskers, continuous range areas, and WCAG 1.4.1 hatch patterns.

components.name: GanttChart
components.description: Temporal schedule and duration visualization component with split-view synchronized scrolling, orthogonal dependency arrows, progress fills, milestones, today markers, and WCAG 1.4.1 hatch patterns.

components.name: ParallelCoordinates
components.description: Multidimensional multivariate visualization component with parallel axes, polyline crossings, 0-100% normalization, cubic spline smoothing, axis reordering, and accessible 1D range brush filtering.

templates.name: Pattern · Asynchronous action
templates.description: Interaction pattern reference implementation, set in a manufacturing ERP — the planning console at the Chakan plant: an MRP regeneration that can block or run in the background, availability checks that overlap and answer out of order, repeat activation suppressed or superseded, retry that resumes rather than repeating completed stages, and a print job whose panel closes while it runs.

templates.name: Pattern · Bulk data import
templates.description: Interaction pattern reference implementation, set in a manufacturing ERP — importing Deccan Machine Supply's catalogue extract into the PL-04 item master: the columns are mapped to fields, every row is judged before anything is written, and 412 of 500 commit while 88 come back for correction.

templates.name: Pattern · Bulk selection and action
templates.description: Interaction pattern reference implementation, set in a manufacturing ERP — posting gate-inward goods receipts: selection by stable identity across pages, a declared aggregate scope, a target snapshot taken at initiation, partial failure that names what remains unresolved, and retry that never repeats a posted line.

templates.name: Pattern · Collection editing
templates.description: Interaction pattern reference implementation, set in a manufacturing ERP — editing the press-shop weekly capacity plan in place: committed values kept apart from drafts, cross-value validation inside the edited slot, cancel that restores, save failure that preserves the draft, and a documented rule for a draft whose slot changed underneath it.

templates.name: Pattern · Collection refinement
templates.description: Interaction pattern reference implementation, set in a manufacturing ERP — triaging the maintenance work request backlog: one canonical criteria model behind every control, active criteria removable from where they are shown, explicit composition rules, immediate or applied refinement, and pagination reconciled when the collection shrinks under it.

templates.name: Layout · Collection workspace
templates.description: One collection as the work surface — the gauge and instrument calibration register at Chakan (PL-04): header and primary actions, search and refinement controls, a conditional bulk-action region, the collection itself, pagination, and the five structural states that can occupy the workspace.

templates.name: Pattern · Conditional input
templates.description: Interaction pattern reference implementation, set in a manufacturing ERP — dispositioning a nonconforming lot: explicit dependency rules, declared retention and unavailability policies, requiredness that follows applicability, and focus rescued out of content that goes away.

templates.name: Pattern · Confirmed action
templates.description: Interaction pattern reference implementation, set in a manufacturing ERP — cancelling a released work order mid-run: initiation kept apart from commitment, the consequence stated in pieces and rupees, a target snapshot revalidated before execution, cancellation with no side effects, and failure that never reads as success.

templates.name: Layout · Dashboard
templates.description: Simultaneous overview of independently meaningful modules — the 07:15 shift-handover dashboard at Chakan (PL-04): output against plan, OEE by line, open nonconformances, overnight breakdowns, material shortages, despatch adherence and the week's losses, on the 12-column grid with shared scope controls.

templates.name: Pattern · Direct manipulation of order
templates.description: Interaction pattern reference implementation, set in a manufacturing ERP — resequencing the routing of BRK-4820-A and subcontracting one of its operations: SortableCollection supplies the grab, the keyboard grab and the legality check; this page owns the order, the commit, the optimism and the rollback.

templates.name: Pattern · Evidence attachment
templates.description: A record that cannot be trusted without its evidence — attaching a calibration certificate before a gauge returns to service

templates.name: Pattern · Explicit save
templates.description: Interaction pattern reference implementation, set in a manufacturing ERP — changing the parameters of a routing operation at the Chakan plant: a draft that never touches the committed routing, cross-field validation before commit, cancel that restores, a documented rule for dismissal while dirty, and a commit failure that keeps every figure the engineer typed.

templates.name: Layout · Holy grail
templates.description: A dominant central workspace between two lateral regions with independent purposes — release criteria on one side, capacity and material constraints on the other, around the press-shop work order release queue for week 2026-W37

templates.name: Layout · Master-detail
templates.description: A collection held beside the item it drives — the expediting queue of overdue purchase-order lines at Chakan (PL-04) on the left, the selected line's schedule, receipts and follow-up actions on the right, with the collection's position, refinement and selection surviving the responsive collapse.

templates.name: Pattern · Recoverable failure
templates.description: Interaction pattern reference implementation, set in a manufacturing ERP — posting the B-shift production confirmations for line PR-05: a failure that keeps the operator's note and the retrieved list, retry scoped to what actually failed, a non-recoverable failure that offers a different route instead of a dead retry, and validation, empty and outage kept as three separate states.

templates.name: Pattern · Search results
templates.description: Interaction pattern reference implementation, set in a manufacturing ERP — item master lookup for a short material: one result set per query state, stale results labelled rather than lied about, no-results and failure kept apart, obsolete responses discarded, pagination reset when the position stops existing.

templates.name: Pattern · Selection-driven detail
templates.description: Interaction pattern reference implementation, set in a manufacturing ERP — the press-shop tool crib: one current die selected in the list, its tool life fetched from MES into a coordinated detail region, with stale responses rejected, a documented rule for a die that leaves the crib, and actions that operate on the selected identity.

templates.name: Layout · Sidebar
templates.description: A secondary region kept continuously beside a dominant one — drawing tolerances held in view while incoming inspection records lot LOT-2609-118

templates.name: Layout · Single column
templates.description: The default frame for content that reads as one vertical sequence — raising a maintenance work request against press line P-2

templates.name: Layout · Split view
templates.description: Two substantial work surfaces side by side — the released machining routing for HSG-3360-B beside the draft revision being written against it under ECN-2026-0412

templates.name: Pattern · Staged input
templates.description: Interaction pattern reference implementation, set in a manufacturing ERP — raising a purchase requisition in ordered stages: validation gates that only look at the current stage, backward movement that commits nothing, a stage that stops applying when the value drops under the approval threshold, and stage data that survives a failed release.

templates.name: Pattern · Validated submission
templates.description: Interaction pattern reference implementation, set in a manufacturing ERP — releasing a work order to a production line: cross-field validation, one snapshot, single-shot commit, values preserved through failure.
